name: Rentiago Rent a Car
title: Car hire in Spain – All-inclusive prices at Rentiago
description: Whether you're looking for a small car, a family car or a convertible, at Rentiago you'll find great deals with unlimited mileage, no excess.
paragraphs: Enjoy the summer with hot deals and unbeatable services from Rentiago.
Flexibility is guaranteed with every car rental: no excess, unlimited mileage, pick-up and return from Monday to Sunday, 24 hours a day.
All-inclusive pricing with full insurance, roadside assistance, unlimited miles, zero deposit, and 0,-€ excess.
Rent a vehicle on the Costa Blanca and explore the whole of Spain. All kilometres and breakdown cover are included.
More flexibility than leasing. Long-term rental for businesses and private individuals starting from just three month.
